803-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-678-2921.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

1661-1903-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-7452.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

277-1308-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1131-7873.description:
Cast Prologue to Phyresis by paying {1}{U}, causing each opponent to get a poison counter and you to draw a card.
Cast Expansion Algorithm by paying {9}{U}{U}, proliferating nine times and causing each opponent to get nine poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1251-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-5173-6798.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-3967-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3430-4499-5478-6973.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Mutable Explorer.
When Mutable Explorer enters, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to Spelunking.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.
3430-4499-5478-6973.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4559-4779-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4779-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3317-5686-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5686-5972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3518-5660-6701.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1636-3755-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

3967-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-3129-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-3129-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1170-1329-1492-6965.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1330-5109-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Truefire Captain instead due to With Great Power....
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

339-677-4050-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5111-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

81-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
81-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

275-5184-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and discard Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Transplant Theorist triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw a card and discard Gilded Assault Cart.
Repeat from step 2.
275-5184-5742-5743.notes: You may resolve the other Transplant Theorist trigger, choosing to loot and get tapped Treasure tokens from Mary Read and Anne Bonny.

890-2410-2500.notablePrerequisites: All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
890-2410-2500.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myr Galvanizer until end of turn.
Activate either Myr Galvanizer or Mirage Mirror by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

152-549-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {8}.
152-549-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
The token Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

2011-2582-5168.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
2011-2582-5168.description:
Declare Najeela, Ahn-Crop Champion and Bloom Tender as attackers, choosing to exert Ahn-Crop Champion as it attacks.
Ahn-Crop Champion and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Ahn-Crop Champion trigger, untapping all other creatures you control.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
